Gideon landed on **280 seats** for Vantorre Group. Use that figure in the QBR deck, not 300.

In the July 1 thread in #strategic-pod, he first said 300. About ten minutes later he corrected it to 280. He said the 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from their May rollout. The 280 is the active seat count on the production roster as of July 1.

You also replied in that thread asking him to update the QBR deck to the corrected roster.
